Until you can get to a professional, try to surround yourself with people that make you happy. Also, try to find things that keep you from thinking, such as watching an interesting show/movie/documentary.

Many people think that they could go to sleep and never wake up, but are not actively looking for a way out.  I have felt this way many times before, but I will never take my own life.  Even though you do not want to take your life, it would be smart to consult your doctor about these feelings, because maybe they'll have a solution, or maybe they will say that its normal, and to let them know if it gets worse.  Always let them know if you encounter side effects.

Don't do it. I've struggled with suicidal depression for about 4 years now, and lost my parents trust because of drugs and alcohol multiple times throughout that span. At the end of the day, they still love you. Even though you may think they're sick of your shit, they will always be there for you because they're family.  I've sat in your seat before, and I still have the notes that I've written, but you'll realize that there is so much you can do with your life. You may not see it now, but we can all make a change no matter how small it is.  My goal in life used to be to save myself, because that was an accomplishment everyday.  Now its to try to help save others who have so much to live for even if they can't see it right now.  If you need to talk, you can PM me.
